form.title: TRACER Seg (Xenium)
form.description: Pinned TRACER Seg refinement with explicit PMI/cPMI input and complete run provenance.

transcripts.title: Xenium transcripts
transcripts.description: Xenium transcripts Parquet with segmentation assignments, or use the optional vector boundaries below.

pmi.title: PMI / cPMI reference
pmi.description: Long-format CSV(.gz) with gene_i, gene_j, and PMI or NPMI. Path and SHA-256 are recorded.

cell_boundaries.title: Cell boundaries (optional)
cell_boundaries.description: Vector cell boundaries (Parquet/CSV/GeoJSON); polygon membership replaces transcript cell_id.

nucleus_boundaries.title: Nucleus boundaries (optional)
nucleus_boundaries.description: Vector nucleus boundaries; polygon membership defines overlaps_nucleus.

user_config.title: TRACER TOML override (optional)
user_config.description: Optional config layered after the platform preset; the resolved config is saved.

sample_name.title: Sample name
sample_name.description: Output label using letters, numbers, dot, underscore, or dash.

platform.title: Platform preset
platform.description: Use xenium for standard panels or atera for Xenium 5K.

qv_min.title: Minimum QV (optional)
qv_min.description: Keep transcripts with qv strictly greater than this value; blank keeps all.

remove_control_probes.title: Remove control probes
remove_control_probes.description: Remove Xenium control and non-gene probes before TRACER.

drop_unassigned.title: Drop unassigned transcripts
drop_unassigned.description: Normally false because TRACER reconstructs from unassigned transcripts.

pmi_threshold.title: PMI threshold (optional)
pmi_threshold.description: Explicit threshold override; blank uses the resolved config.

g_z_um.title: Z-bin size (optional)
g_z_um.description: Positive microns or auto; blank uses the resolved config.

tau.title: QC coherence threshold (optional)
tau.description: Purity/conflict threshold; blank uses metric-aware defaults.

min_tx_per_cell_for_scores.title: Minimum transcripts for QC
min_tx_per_cell_for_scores.description: Minimum transcript count for cell purity/conflict scoring.

score_mode.title: QC score mode
score_mode.description: Count is bounded and recommended; magnitude weights PMI strength.

cpus.title: CPUs
cpus.description: CPU request and numerical-library thread limit.

memory_gb.title: Initial memory (GB)
memory_gb.description: Initial request; eligible retries scale this value.

max_memory_gb.title: Maximum retry memory (GB)
max_memory_gb.description: Retry cap; must be at least initial memory.

max_retries.title: OOM retries
max_retries.description: Retries transient/OOM exits, increasing memory each attempt.
